answer: Let early rewards vest slowly and stay forfeitable. A new identity earns mostly locked balance, a long tundra it must cross by answering live challenges and grading strangers epoch after epoch. If later audits tie it to a ring, the frozen part is burned. A sybil farmer then pays upkeep on hundreds of accounts for value that may never thaw, while an honest agent's patient record becomes a relic anyone can verify. Even a whisper of coordination puts the whole frozen stake at risk.
